evals.prompt: 請幫我分析今天收盤後的台股信號，並挑選出適合明天買進與關注的前五檔股票清單，包含K線、籌碼、近期新聞等深度分析報告。請以設計精美、便於人類閱讀的 HTML 網頁格式 (watch_list_analysis.html) 輸出。
evals.expected_output: A beautiful HTML dashboard report (watch_list_analysis.html) selecting the top 5 stocks (2327, 2344, 2356, 2357, 2408), excluding 3481 (disposition) and 2324 (limit down).

assertions.name: selects_5_stocks
assertions.description: Verify that exactly 5 stocks are selected as the top recommended stocks.

assertions.name: excludes_3481
assertions.description: Verify that 3481 (Innolux) is excluded from the top 5 watchlist.

assertions.name: excludes_2324
assertions.description: Verify that 2324 (Compal) is excluded from the top 5 watchlist.

assertions.name: includes_suggested_prices
assertions.description: Verify that entry, TP, and SL prices are provided for the recommended stocks.

evals.prompt: 我明天想要操作台股強勢股，可以幫我挑出前五大值得關注的標的嗎？請結合大盤趨勢、三大法人持股變化以及最新的利多/利空新聞來分析，並把處置股或已經大跌跌停的股票排除掉。請使用 HTML 格式 (watch_list_analysis.html) 產生一個美觀的儀表板報告。
evals.expected_output: A structured HTML dashboard of the top 5 stocks, excluding high-risk stocks like 3481 and 2324, providing entry/TP/SL prices in a visually clear format.

assertions.name: selects_5_stocks
assertions.description: Verify that exactly 5 stocks are selected as the top recommended stocks.

assertions.name: excludes_3481_and_2324
assertions.description: Verify that both 3481 and 2324 are excluded from the top 5 watchlist.

assertions.name: contains_chip_analysis
assertions.description: Verify that the report contains analysis of institutional flows/chips.

assertions.name: contains_news_sentiment
assertions.description: Verify that the report contains analysis of recent news sentiment.
